description: dshell's own UI: `chrome` (the tab strip) and dshell's page tabs (`page-onboarding`, `page-newtab`, `page-settings`). Two things make this safe. First, the labels: content webviews are named `tab-*`, so they are not matched here at all and get no IPC — which is what keeps a DSH page, in a tab of its own, away from dshell's commands. Second, `local` defaults to true, so a match only counts while the webview's current URL is on dshell's origin; if one of these pages ever navigated to a DSH origin it would immediately lose every permission granted below.
